messages.game.1ff3f74ada4dd92a: A town lined with warehouses that have heavy doors. It's really lively right now.
messages.game.01ff7edc80209ef7: ...But there's one person in trouble. The kanji 家 (house) is rampaging, and they can't read the nameplate.
messages.game.0a44f5d04040e509: For 家 (house), picture everyone together under one roof.
messages.game.fe118bf0796a559f: To remember 親 (parent), picture someone watching over their child from a tree. ...Look, the delivery arrived!
messages.game.acce74563857405b: The delivery person said, 'You saved me!' ...See? Being able to read makes you happy, doesn't it.
messages.game.c34322cbc6fef796: A town in the mountains. There's a small school where you can hear the river.
messages.game.2474890504b8644c: The kanji in 教室 (classroom) is rampaging, and no one can get inside.
messages.game.c05bae6ad3d8bb8e: 図 (pictures and diagrams), and things people 書 (write)—this school has them all.
messages.game.b7920fc32846da23: We opened the 国語 (Japanese language) textbook... Look, someone came in!
messages.game.50b011aadc2577ad: The teacher said this: 'There was someone who taught me that kanji is fun. ...In a big voice, all the time.'
messages.game.4e39640bafd37c8e: A mountain of sharply pointed rocks. The road splits in two.
messages.game.ceabdb24444487b3: The kanji 谷 (valley) is rampaging, so the signboard can't be read. ...Oh.
messages.game.73832e8a766ca2c4: That kid taught them first. ...The truly safe way, too.
messages.game.2914ea0500158dd7: 谷 (valley) is the space between mountains. The 高 (high/ higher) one is this road.
messages.game.223a18fcc1139a3a: A big red-brick factory and vast mulberry fields. A town that makes thread.
messages.game.2b53c0c0b2b06db1: The kanji 園 (garden/field) went rampant, and the silkworms' leaves got mixed up with people's food.
messages.game.f4f9b8d30d145f7c: 麦 (wheat) and 米 (rice) are both food for people. Silkworms eat only mulberry leaves.
messages.game.ef9306df52542602: You can't tell by looks alone. ...But you can tell with kanji. See? It's sorted!
messages.game.cdaad75852145bae: ...Hey. It seems like there's a bigger one up ahead.
messages.game.ea8fc3a586bd043f: An old temple lined with vermilion gates. It's full of visitors.
messages.game.c9de8cbbce3eed3e: The kanji 門 (gate) is rampaging, and some people can't tell where to enter.
messages.game.3f5372446e8e8d04: A town where 古 (old) things and things of 今 (now) stand side by side.
messages.game.d1eb33457841666e: The 新 (new) signboards are all pictures. ...But the kanji on the old 門 (gate) can be read. This is the entrance!
messages.game.f1681b77d944ab73: ...That round mark is everywhere, isn't it. Everyone's glad it made things easier.
messages.game.b70adaabf679e174: 午前 (a.m.), 午後 (p.m.), and 半 (half). ...If you can read them, you understand the time.
messages.game.f2ab74f5823e44fb: Look. ...Those people met up at the underground entrance!
messages.game.1fe57fd1c8785507: ...See? When you can read by yourself, you can be a little proud, right?
messages.game.e2d0cafa4a8d90f9: A gentle plateau road. A place where the maples turn red in autumn.
messages.game.f488fabc796dfa04: The 線 (lines) on the picture map went rampant, and no one can tell whether the thick one or the thin one is the road.
messages.game.7ce93f06876146e6: The 太 (thick) one is the big road. The 細 (thin) one is a path.
messages.game.607ebf9e2f17c222: Look at the colors too. 黄 (yellow) is fields, 黒 (black) is forest. ...Now you won't get lost!
messages.game.479dcf331d960752: The person at the information office said this: 'There was someone who wrote down the meanings of the lines on paper and taught people as they went.'
messages.game.55a4b06e3176e7fb: A torii gate stands on a rock amid the waves.
messages.game.485fd5d725cdf7cd: The kanji 近 (near) is rampaging, and no one knows when it's okay to get 近 (close). It's dangerous.
messages.game.7460574a8f35775f: It's okay to 近 (approach) when the waves have drawn back.
messages.game.04b5dd67d088527a: Days to watch from 遠 (far) away, and days you can go right 近 (close). ...It was written there!
messages.game.be062950d8cf4bd9: The shrine person said, 'Now I feel safe.' ...That's good, isn't it.
messages.game.a30807144709212c: 理 (reason/logic) is the thread that runs through things. You 知 (know), then 考 (think), and only then do you understand.
messages.game.ba9de89c7b6ab084: ...What I'm doing right now is exactly that.
messages.game.dbbc758b428782d6: The person at the research institute said this: 'That person might know. Someone who travels around teaching kanji.'
messages.game.ba5f4541b008201f: A lake as wide as the sea. Boats with white sails are floating on it.
messages.game.436a0a6ad811b0f8: The kanji 北 (north) is rampaging, so the direction signs can't be read. Someone is going around in circles.
messages.game.8ea727a49f90fd4a: Once you know 北 (north), you know 東 (east), 西 (west), and 南 (south) too.
messages.game.ddeb67042123e2d1: A sailing boat advances by watching its 方 (direction). ...Look, it came back!
messages.game.55098a09a82784ea: A small child said happily, 'I don't know the way. But that kid is here, so it's okay.'
messages.game.6d4a464bae507dbd: Flower fields stretch out as far as the eye can see, and beyond them you can see the sea.
messages.game.e44f54dc6ec46117: The kanji 春 (spring) is rampaging, so the peak-bloom signs can't be read.
messages.game.b45b55afe62116ab: Flowers that bloom in 春 (spring) and flowers that bloom in 夏 (summer). It was written on the signs!
messages.game.9021726fd891fbac: The 昼 (daytime) of a 晴 (clear) day. ...Right now is the most beautiful moment.
messages.game.8a8eb308b2d5619b: ...Hey. From across the sea, I can sense the presence of a big one.
messages.game.6d3118ac5fb7346e: A temple with a great tower. A long stone-stair approach continues on and on.
messages.game.ca9e95bd6beb95a7: There are lots of kanji here, so lots of people are in trouble. The kanji 読 (read) is rampaging.
messages.game.c85e9f50f999e545: 読 (reading) and 聞 (hearing) are different. ...Which one stays in your 心 (heart)?
messages.game.bf654d8a447a9deb: (Try reading it yourself) ...Yes. That is what 読 (reading) means.
messages.game.d7e9dc0258ba9c96: The person on the stone steps said this: 'There was someone who talked on and on about the joys of kanji. ...It was a long talk.'
messages.game.29c851f6b8c2bc14: A wall of rock cut away in square blocks. Stone stairs continue all the way up.
messages.game.d3c2d0aced0a9168: The kanji 止 (stop) is rampaging, so the 止まれ (stop) sign can't be read. It's dangerous.
messages.game.381643557cdd917c: To remember 止 (stop), picture someone bringing their feet together and standing still.
messages.game.b8d0a8916744da48: If going 直 (straight) ahead is dangerous, 止 (stop). ...Now everyone knows what to do!
messages.game.475e46f737476088: The stone cutter said this: 'A person with a big back comes by sometimes.'
messages.game.88bfc2395d663d53: A red and gold gate. A town lined with big lanterns.
messages.game.b5cef5ad40610ab9: 番 (number) is running wild, so no one can read the price tags or numbers.
messages.game.a0b4be1b8bbb69db: The person who 売 (sells) and the person who 買 (buys). With kanji, they can talk.
messages.game.f24103e7a0679b9a: ...That kid has made kanji their friends too. About the same age as you.
messages.game.323da44a1577c6e4: ...But that kid has a 'I have to memorize this' look. ...You look like you're having fun.
messages.game.67f92d2319b1ccc7: Red-brick warehouses, and a wharf where big ships dock.
messages.game.a5ae871cfe28883a: The kanji 会 (meet) is rampaging, so the meeting place can't be read.
messages.game.d5c1a0030b5f1fb8: 会 (meeting) is things 合 (coming together). That's all it is, yet without kanji it can't be done.
messages.game.6c1a6e69065ce9a9: The person at the wharf said this: 'The person who travels around teaching kanji left on this ship.'
messages.game.e1fbf9900d9d68f9: A great Buddha sits quietly. The sea is right there, too.
messages.game.678efcac42033ece: The 体 (body), the 頭 (head), the 首 (neck) — all stone, and yet... it seems alive.
messages.game.21739f3fbae2c634: ...A big back. ...Hey. I wonder if that person's back felt like this, too.
messages.game.445d388d40528980: This is a big underground hall, left over from quarrying out the rock.
messages.game.ef1f564df1bf048b: 時 (time) is running wild. People can't read the tour time. …Oh.
messages.game.b7c7503d82646ba9: It's okay. I'll read it. 午前10時半: 10:30 a.m. 午前 means morning, and 半 means half.
messages.game.11b93437134c65a4: You came here to have fun, right? I'll handle the hard stuff.
messages.game.88a70e64c2d82a51: …Thank you. That really helps me out.
messages.game.1b7d1c42e478c245: …But you should try reading it yourself. It's more fun that way.
messages.game.14811e9ff95a485e: A town of white research labs. A town of people who think: 考える.
messages.game.1351befb72ea4775: …I do research here too. Let me show you.
messages.game.60e8858710222fff: Wherever the characters rampage, the broad-shouldered figure shows up. …Every single time.
messages.game.4425415c1e3dd8ca: …Did the kanji go wild because that person came? Or did that person come because they went wild?
messages.game.14eaf318de2b8cff: I don't know that yet. So I can't say anything yet.
